description: Phase 11 (Carry-In Closure, umbrella) is wholly superseded by Phase 11.1 (Carry-In Closure Harnesses) which carries the full LIVECLOSE-01..05 requirement set. The umbrella's REQ set is empty (the umbrella was abandoned before requirements were listed under it), so the superset rule trivially fires: ∅ ⊆ {LIVECLOSE-01..05}. The verb must rewrite the umbrella's ROADMAP row from `[ ] Phase 11: Carry-In Closure` to `[⊘] Phase 11: Carry-In Closure — superseded by Phase 11.1`. Source-of-truth canonical anchor for upstream SDK port of `gsd-sdk query roadmap.analyze --apply`.
coverage_invariant: Phase N.M's requirement set ⊇ Phase N's requirement set AND Phase N.M is complete AND Phase N is the immediate-decimal-parent (no integer-prefix collisions). Empty umbrella REQ set (∅ ⊆ any) trivially satisfies the superset check.
